card.name: The word enzyme before replacement therapy
card.fires_on: The word enzyme (or the final e of Enzyme) right before 'replacement therapy' in drug labels. Also hormone before 'replacement'.

modes.label: Enzyme replacement therapy

modes.label: Hormone replacement
